keyFindings.description: Regression introduced by 4268e56e: `prompted()` returns True the moment it sees a prompt line, whether or not it ever finds the block's closing fence, so an unclosed session block sets `prompts_only` to the end of the file and every later non-prompt line is skipped — including the lines of a well-formed ```sh block below it. Reproduced at this head: a guide with an unclosed ```console block carrying `$ bun run lint .`, then a ```sh block whose line is `bunx biome check .`, leaves the whole gate green; the same tree at 9bb1ba35 reported it. The header's own sentence scopes the convention to the lines 'to the line that closes it', so a block with no closer has no convention to read: return False when the scan reaches EOF.

The second pass added with the backslash fix returns a shorter command for a line whose quotes do not balance, so everything after that line's first `#` is judged by nothing. Reproduced at this head: `echo "a # b && bunx biome check .` and its single-quote twin are both unreported, where the guard at 9bb1ba35 reported both. It is the one place this gate guesses rather than refusing, against the header's own posture at :108-114 ('what the tokenizer cannot read, it refuses'), and no case pins the fail-closed direction. Either return the whole line as the command and take only the comment from the re-scan — the marker still works on an apostrophe line — or keep the behaviour with a case that pins it and a header sentence admitting the exception.

Both numeric knobs accept a leading zero the `*[!0-9]*` guard was written to reject. Measured: `LEGION_SETUP_BUDGET=08` makes `$(($(date +%s) + budget))` an octal parse that dash — the worker image's /bin/sh — ends with `Illegal number: 08`, exit 2, which is the one thing this script must never do (it stops Oh My Pi and charges the launch a failure); `LEGION_SETUP_LOCK_HOLD=00` passes the `| 0` arm, so the clamp sets `left=00` and `timeout -k 5 00` is GNU timeout's no-timeout-at-all — the unbounded hold on the shared cache lock the architect's ruling exists to prevent. Reject a leading zero in both arms, and say in one line why the `| 0` arm is load-bearing, since it looks like an inconsistency with `budget`'s case and is not.

A `lock-timeout` reached after this run's own install — the retry takes the lock, installs, fails the cold-entry copy, and loses the `flock -w` race on its second attempt — keeps the marker and carries a comment asserting the run 'never held the lock, never looked at node_modules, and learned nothing about what is installed', which is false on that path; the report also drops the install log's tail it does have. The first attempt's status is enough to tell the two apart. Same comment region: 124 now means both the budget and the hold cutting the install off, and the comment at :384-385 names only the budget, so the agent's notice cannot tell a slow container from a yielded lock.

The operator paragraph now says 'It bounds itself once, as a whole' three lines above 'A second bound sits inside that one', and the insertion lands between the budget's clause and its 275 s worst case, so 'that budget' resolves across a sentence about another number. This is the page an operator reads before lowering `worker_boot_timeout_seconds`, which is the reader the new sentences address.

verified: Round 2's seven findings re-checked by running them: the escaped-quote fail-open is closed, the walk names a mode-000 directory with no traceback, a prompted session block is judged at its prompts while its output lines naming tsc and playwright are not, an unprompted one is judged line by line, `ranInstall` gives the right introducer for all five reasons with the retry advice unconditional, the marker survives a waiter that never held the lock, and the hold is min(remaining, hold) computed inside the lock with docs/kubernetes.md's sizing paragraph naming this script among the inode's holders. All sixteen threads carry my answer and stay resolved.
CI at code head 49dbf0c0: 25 check runs, all success or skipped including `dispatch`; the required lint, typecheck, test and pr-title green; compare 49dbf0c0...c46e07d7 is .legion/ only.
